snippet.title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Direct 3.27.2025
snippet.description:
Pokémon Legends: Z-A releases for Nintendo Switch on Oct. 16, 2025. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pokemon-legends-z-a-switch/?utm_source=SW-AAA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=N1149-01&utm_id=N1149-01

Welcome to Lumiose City, where skilled Trainers participate in the Z-A Royale, a tournament where you’ll rank up via unique new Pokémon battles that happen in real time and can feature Mega Evolutions!

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot
